noticias.titulo: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq slip as Alphabet stock sinks 12% and AI jitters return
noticias.resumo: Tech stocks snapped a positive run this week as investors digested the Fed's rate pause on Wednesday and earnings from Microsoft (MSFT) and Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL), the parent company of Google.  Microsoft beat analyst expectations on the top and bottom lines, while Alphabet's sales came up short.  Cloud growth was up 103%, but concerns about the tech giant's free cash flow and AI return on investment were the albatross around the company's stock, which sank more than 12%.
